_jobApplication.jobDescription: Pencil (Generative AI SaaS for advertising / content creation; mission: make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people). Remote. Strategic and technical owner of transformation engagements on a set of accounts: the most informed voice on what Pencil should do for each client and how the work gets done. Set the thesis, structure the engagement from first principles, co-design recommendations and timelines with Forward Deployed Engineers and Creative Leads, lead the client through enterprise-wide change to make it stick, and stand behind quality and performance once work ships. Responsibilities: implementation leadership (own the client narrative and strategic/tactical plan, set the transformation thesis); structured problem-solving (turn ambiguous problems into hypotheses, workstreams, sequenced decisions); change management leadership (move clients beyond siloed pilots into integrated AI-driven workflows, navigate stakeholders, engineer buy-in for scaled adoption); AI process design (translate GenAI concepts into repeatable operating processes); product feedback loop (voice of the customer to Product/Engineering); transformation blueprints (codify wins into repeatable playbooks). Background: 5+ years in consulting, in-house transformation, programme management, or enterprise tech implementation with exposure to technology, digital strategy, and/or operations; strong quantitative/analytical academic record (STEM, economics, engineering, business); AI-native day-to-day (uses Claude Cowork; Claude Code or agentic tooling a plus; automates by default); tech-fluent and hands-on (configures agents, prototypes, stress-tests recommendations, can hold a technical conversation with a client's engineers; lightweight engineering like SQL/scripts/reading code a plus); confident with senior stakeholders (carry a client meeting solo, give direct feedback, composed under scope shifts); track record delivering complex, cross-functional, ambiguous work to a high standard on time; marketing/advertising/agency experience helps but is not a differentiator. Thrive: provocative and brave, ally to change, believe in enterprise adoption (out of pilot purgatory), measurable impact. KPIs: enterprise adoption, time-to-value/ROI, quality of transformation narrative, product feedback impact, blueprint contribution.
_jobApplication.notes: Strong fit: owns AI transformation end to end (LumApps, Anand Creations FDE practice), enterprise adoption beyond pilots (AI Onboarding Specialist 100% of customers, templating engine at 15% of assets), repeatable blueprints/playbooks (reusable modules, reference architectures, 'Blueprint for High-Impact Teams'), first-principles structured problem-solving + executive advisory (Tenity, MBA), AI-native hands-on builder (Claude, Claude Code, agents), quantitative academic record (multiple MSc + MBA 93.2%). Advertising adjacency via Proplab (AI marketing content generation) and Beekeeper GenAI content system. Honest notes: background is engineering/founder rather than a classic management-consulting title, and no direct advertising/agency tenure (JD says that helps but does not set candidates apart); has not used the specific Claude Cowork product but is AI-native with Claude/Claude Code and agentic tooling.
